titleEn: Foley artists are rarer than astronauts, yet cinema wouldn’t be possible without them
titleZh: 拟音师比宇航员还稀少，但电影离不开他们
method: Machine reference translation with paragraph alignment; not manually certified.

paragraphs.en: John Roesch has spent more than 40 years creating sounds for a lot of the most iconic films ever produced. Films such as The Empire Strikes Back (1980), E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial (1982), Back To The Future (1985), The Matrix (1999), The Dark Knight (2008) and Interstellar (2014). Have you heard of him before?
paragraphs.zh: John Roesch已经花了超过40年的时间为许多最具代表性的电影制作声音。电影包括《帝国反击战》（1980），《外星人E.T.》（1982），《回到未来》（1985），《黑客帝国》（1999），《黑暗骑士》（2008）和《星际穿越》（2014）。你以前听说过他吗？

paragraphs.en: John has a saying about his job: there are more astronauts in the world than working professional Foley artists.
paragraphs.zh: 约翰对他的工作有一种说法：世界上的宇航员比工作的专业福利艺术家还要多。

paragraphs.en: Foley is the craft of performing and recording sounds for motion pictures. In its purest form, it involves sounds recorded in a studio. The artist watches the film and generates sounds to accompany the visuals unfolding onscreen: the light thud of footsteps, the rustle of clothing, the clink of a glass picked up off a table.
paragraphs.zh: Foley是为电影表演和录制声音的工艺。在其最纯粹的形式中，它涉及在录音室录制的声音。艺术家观看电影，并产生声音来伴随视觉效果的展开：脚步声，衣服的沙沙声，从桌子上拿起玻璃杯的叮当声。

paragraphs.en: You’ll have heard these sounds in many of the films you’ve watched – and you’ve almost certainly never thought about where they come from. That’s the point.
paragraphs.zh: 在你看过的许多电影中，你都会听到这些声音--你几乎肯定从来没有想过它们来自哪里。

paragraphs.en: When sound entered the picture
paragraphs.zh: 当声音进入画面时

paragraphs.en: Foley is named after Jack Foley (1891–1967), a sound effects artist who worked at Universal Pictures. He started there in 1914, the silent era, when audiences watched films in silence, or with a pianist playing live in the cinema.
paragraphs.zh: Foley是以Jack Foley（1891-1967）的名字命名的，他是一位在环球影业工作的音效艺术家。他于1914年在那里开始工作，那是一个无声的时代，观众在无声的情况下观看电影，或者在电影院里有钢琴家现场演奏。

paragraphs.en: The arrival of synchronised dialogue in Warner Bros’ The Jazz Singer (1927) launched the age of the “talkies”; but dialogue was basically the only thing early microphones could pick up.
paragraphs.zh: 华纳兄弟的《爵士歌手》（1927）中同步对话的到来开启了“有声电影”的时代;但对话基本上是早期麦克风唯一能听到的东西。

paragraphs.en: Not long after, Universal produced a musical called Show Boat, and decided it needed sound – something audiences were increasingly coming to expect. Foley and his colleagues stood beside the screen and performed footsteps and other effects that would later be added to the picture.
paragraphs.zh: 不久之后，环球制作了一部音乐剧《Show Boat》，并决定它需要声音--这是观众越来越期待的东西。福利和他的同事站在屏幕旁，表演脚步声和其他效果，这些效果后来被添加到画面中。

paragraphs.en: Show Boat became the first non-silent musical to use Foley’s technique, which he refined over the following decades – often without screen credits.
paragraphs.zh: 《秀船》成为第一部使用福利技巧的非无声音乐剧，他在接下来的几十年里不断完善这种技巧--通常没有银幕上的学分。

paragraphs.en: Most of us have a list of our favourite films and TV series of all time. But do you ever wonder how these were made?
paragraphs.zh: 我们大多数人都有一张我们最喜欢的电影和电视剧的清单。但是你有没有想过这些是如何制作的？

paragraphs.en: In this series we go behind the scenes to reveal the ingenious tricks and innovations that have transformed screen production over the course of a century.
paragraphs.zh: 在这个系列中，我们将深入幕后，揭示在世纪的过程中改变屏幕制作的巧妙技巧和创新。

paragraphs.en: Snakes in my mac and cheese
paragraphs.zh: 奶酪通心粉里有蛇

paragraphs.en: Today, one of the most celebrated sound designers in cinema is Ben Burtt. For Raiders of the Lost Ark (1981), he created the sound of snakes slithering across the floor of the Egyptian tomb by running his fingers through a dish of macaroni and cheese.
paragraphs.zh: 如今，本·伯特是电影界最著名的声音设计师之一。在1981年的《夺宝方舟》中，他用手指划过一盘通心粉和奶酪，创造了蛇在埃及陵墓地板上滑行的声音。

paragraphs.en: Burtt also created what is possibly the most famous sound effect in the history of cinema: the light sabre swoosh. For this, he used a directional microphone to record the hum of a film projector being played through speakers. He waved the microphone in front of the speakers, imitating the characters on screen.
paragraphs.zh: 伯特还创造了可能是电影史上最著名的音效：光剑嗖嗖声。为此，他用定向麦克风记录了电影放映机通过扬声器播放的嗡嗡声。他在扬声器前挥舞麦克风，模仿屏幕上的人物。

paragraphs.en: This created a combination of sonic effects, including a doppler shift (the change in pitch when the source of a sound is moving), along with swells and fades in volume as the microphone passed each speaker.
paragraphs.zh: 这就产生了一种声音效果的组合，包括多普勒频移（声源移动时音调的变化），以及麦克风经过每个扬声器时音量的沿着起伏。

paragraphs.en: Foley also steers where we look onscreen, and how we feel. A close rustle of fabric during a tense scene can pull us inside a character’s head, as we hear what they’re hearing.
paragraphs.zh: 福利还能引导我们看起来不舒服的地方，以及我们的感受。在紧张的场景中，织物的近距离沙沙声可以把我们拉进角色的脑海，因为我们听到了他们所听到的。

paragraphs.en: The sound team behind The Lord of the Rings trilogy, led by David Farmer, Ethan Van der Ryn and Mike Hopkins, became known for their inventive Foley methods. They built the enormous audible world of Middle Earth from scratch – every sword shing, armour-plated boot, chainmail clink and bridle jingle.
paragraphs.zh: 由大卫·法默（David Farmer）、伊森·范德瑞恩（Ethan货车der Ryn）和迈克·霍普金斯（Mike Hopkins）领导的《指环王》三部曲的音效团队，以其富有创造性的弗利音效而闻名。他们从零开始打造了中土世界巨大的声音世界--每一次剑鸣、装甲靴子、锁子甲叮当声和缰绳叮当声。

paragraphs.en: They also spent many late nights recording real bow and arrow draw, release and impact sounds at a nearby graveyard for realism.
paragraphs.zh: 他们还花了许多深夜记录真实的弓箭提请，释放和影响的声音在附近的墓地的现实主义。

paragraphs.en: This effort in sound acquisition creates a massive job for sound editors after the fact. Hundreds of recordings need to be sorted, compiled and synced into a mix.
paragraphs.zh: 这种声音采集的努力为事后的声音编辑创造了大量的工作。数百个录音需要分类、编译和同步到一个混音中。

paragraphs.en: In praise of Foley
paragraphs.zh: 饰Foley

paragraphs.en: Despite these examples, Foley recorded specifically for a film or television show is rare.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管有这些例子，福利专门为电影或电视节目录制的是罕见的。

paragraphs.en: This type of bespoke sound work takes money, time, hundreds of props, and a skilled team. A typical independent production, meanwhile, will have one sound designer (maybe two) and a deadline.
paragraphs.zh: 这种定制的声音作品需要金钱、时间、数百个道具和一个熟练的团队。与此同时，一个典型的独立制作将有一个声音设计师（可能是两个）和一个截止日期。

paragraphs.en: With such limited resources, it’s often not viable to record organic sound, such as for footsteps, on location. Location audio is often noisy and uncontrolled – not to mention the picture edit isn’t locked in yet.
paragraphs.zh: 由于资源有限，在外景地录制自然声音（如脚步声）通常是不可行的。外景地音频通常嘈杂且不受控制-更不用说图片编辑尚未锁定。

paragraphs.en: This means the sounds of the footsteps in the film you watched last week may have come from a pre-recorded sound library.
paragraphs.zh: 这意味着你上周看的电影中的脚步声可能来自预先录制的声音库。

paragraphs.en: As a sound designer myself, I’ve spent a lot of time sifting through libraries to add footsteps, clothing and general human movement sounds to film and television soundtracks. Sometimes I’m adding these sounds to what was recorded on location, and sometimes I’m replacing it because it wasn’t usable.
paragraphs.zh: 作为一名声音设计师，我花了很多时间在电影和电视的配乐中添加脚步声、衣服声和一般的人类运动声。有时我会把这些声音添加到现场录制的声音中，有时我会把它们替换掉，因为它们不能用。

paragraphs.en: But this work is far from simple. A sound library file often won’t precisely match the specific environment of a scene, or the pace, or the weight of the person interacting with the environment. This creates a disconnect; something will feel off to the viewer even if they can’t explain it.
paragraphs.zh: 但这项工作并不简单。声音库文件通常不会精确匹配场景的特定环境，或与环境交互的人的速度或体重。这会产生脱节;即使观众无法解释，也会感觉到一些东西。

paragraphs.en: A sound designer working with libraries has to make each sound fit the scene by using other processes such as equalisation, which shapes its tone, and reverb, which places it in the right kind of environment.
paragraphs.zh: 与图书馆合作的声音设计师必须通过使用其他过程使每个声音适合场景，例如塑造音调的均衡和将其置于正确环境中的混响。

paragraphs.en: While they may be rarer than astronauts, Foley artists carry a peculiar and fascinating responsibility: to keep an audience immersed in a story without reminding them they’re watching one.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然他们可能比宇航员还罕见，但福利艺术家肩负着一项特殊而迷人的责任：让观众沉浸在一个故事中，而不提醒他们正在观看一个故事。
